notes.title: SASS VS FASH KICKSTARTER - ROUND 2!!
notes.notes:
It's been so long. We're still on a long road to finish the game, but we've recently started grabbing this bull again by the horns and continue the development, no matter the cost.

And, as an additional aid, we've recently launched a Kickstarter campaign for the game for a second round!

We've learnt from our mistakes in our prior fundraiser, but with this we hope we have improved on our craft, and we made this Kickstarter campaign especially to cover up the sunken costs of development that will come in the following months.

Go check out our Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jmaa/sass-vs-fash-girlballs-of-steel-round-2-fundraiser]here[/url]. It will launch on next month, on February 1st. Be sure to follow us there for the launch!

notes.title: Sass VS Fash Fanart Twitter Contest!
notes.notes:
Figured we could do a little bit of a contest... don't worry, there are some financial incentives by the end of this month, hopefully.

The Sass VS Fash fanart with the most likes on Twitter will get PayPal'd $100 USD! The deadline is on [strike]August 1st, 2023[/strike] September 1st, 2023!

Submit your fanart by tweeting [url=https://twitter.com/DrilSargeant]@DrilSargeant[/url] on Twitter with the hashtags #SassVSFash and #GoodNaziDeadNazi by the deadline!

The only rule is no bigotry or hate speech. NSFW is also allowed!

Go forth and screw over nazis!

notes.title: You can donate extra to Sass VS Fash now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Antifa internet denizens.

We have recently set up a donation DLC which you can additionally buy along the game to not only get extra goodies in the form of soundtrack tidbits and exclusive concept artwork but also support further the development of this game.

This is very important since we really need to make up the threshold of Steam payouts in order to actually get the development minimally funded. It will be all worth it anyway.

You can buy the donation DLC separately or buy it in the Sass VS Fash + Extra Donation bundle, which contains said DLC and the original game.

Happy Nazi Hunting!

notes.title: STEAM EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #1
notes.notes: Here the settings menu, at least for graphics and audio, has been completely fixed, and now you can properly set the video settings and quality and audio volume. Might not be perfect, but it should be decent now.

notes.title: The game is out now on Early Access!
notes.notes:
Sass VS Fash is out now on Early Access!

Now you can get a taste of what's planned with the upcoming full release. We hope you enjoy this version of the game!

Feel free to discuss any feedback on the Steam discussions page of this game.

notes.title: Sass VS Fash coming soon to Early Access!
notes.notes:
The Steam page for Sass VS Fash is now live, and with it, the Early Access version of the game will be live on January 2nd 2023!

With this, we hope we can plan ahead to continue the development of this game, and bring you some more kickass nazi killing in the process. We can't wait to see you slaughter some fascists in this game!
